newsitem.title: JAPAN: NCB says it, two others to support Sanyo Sec -Jiji.
newsitem.headline: NCB says it, two others to support Sanyo Sec -Jiji.

text.p: Nippon Credit Bank Ltd (NCB) said that it would cooperate with Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd (BTM) and Nomura Securities Co Ltd to support Sanyo Securities Co Ltd's restructuring efforts, Jiji news agency said on Wednesday.

NCB Vice President Shigeoki Togo, who is scheduled to take over as the bank's president next month, also said it is likely that life insurers will comply with Sanyo's request for a delay in the repayment of subordinated loans, Jiji said.
He made the remarks in an interview with Jiji.
"If financial institutions (that have business ties with Sanyo) support Sanyo, I believe, and I hope, that the brokerage can do business (without difficulties)," Jiji quoted Togo as saying.

Sanyo faces financial difficulties due to problem loans held at affiliated firms and protracted sluggishness in the stock market. To help bail out its group firms, the second-tier brokerage launched a nine-year restructuring programme in the 1994/95 business year.

Sanyo received subordinated loans from several major life insurance companies, including Nippon Life Insurance Co and Dai-Ichi Mutual Life Insurance Co, in an effort to increase its capital and strengthen its financial position.
Sanyo has asked life insurers for a delay in the repayment of subordinated loans that fall due at the end of July, 1998.
